title: The RSV Genesis opening says God created the heavens and the earth
summary: The RSV of Genesis 1:1 says God created the heavens and the earth.
body: The Revised Standard Version of Genesis 1:1 says that in the beginning God created the heavens and the earth. That is a statement of the text. It is not a measurement from geology. The wording on the page includes: "CUVS CUV CUVMPS CUVMPT RCU17SS RCU17TS Update Six Days of Creation and the Sabbath 1 In the beginning God created[a] the heavens and the earth. 2 The earth was without form and void, and darkness was upon the face of the deep; and the Spirit[b] of God was moving over the face of the waters. 3 And God said, “Let there be light”; and there was light. 4 And God saw that". The evidence label is the truth-gate ceiling for this host. The host is not on the gate's primary-text or official list, so the label is weak. The quotation is still the page's wording.
